targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN YEAR(Last_Working_Day) = 2025 THEN EmployeeID END) AS Leavers_2025,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN YEAR(Entry_Date) = 2025 THEN EmployeeID END) AS Joiners_2025
FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_LOC01".HR."OD_Hire"
where Department in ($Department)

SELECT 
    -- Turnover Rate
    ROUND(
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "Last_Working_Day") = 2025 THEN "EmployeeID" END) * 1.0
        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "EmployeeID"), 0) * 100, 
        1
    ) AS turnover_rate,

    -- Average Age (active employees only)
    (
        SELECT ROUND(AVG(age), 2)
        FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT "EmployeeID", age
            FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_LOC01".HR."OD_Hire"
            WHERE "Last_Working_Day" IS NULL
            and  Department in ($Department)

        ) sub_age
    ) AS avg_age,
    
    (
        SELECT ROUND(MAX(age), 1)
        FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT "EmployeeID", age
            FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_LOC01".HR."OD_Hire"
            WHERE "Last_Working_Day" IS NULL
            and  Department in ($Department)


        ) sub_age
    ) AS max_age,

    -- Average Seniority
    (
        SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST("Seniority" AS FLOAT)), 2)
        FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_LOC01".HR."OD_Hire"
        where Department in ($Department)

    ) AS avg_seniority,

    (
        SELECT ROUND(MAX(CAST("Seniority" AS FLOAT)), 1)
        FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_LOC01".HR."OD_Hire"
        WHERE  Department in ($Department)

    ) AS max_seniority

FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_LOC01".HR."OD_Hire"
where Department in ($Department)

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT "EmployeeID") AS total_employees,

    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "Gender" = 'Female' and Employee_Type = 'WC' THEN "EmployeeID" END) AS female_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "Gender" = 'Female'  THEN "EmployeeID" END) AS female_count_total,

    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "Gender" = 'Male' THEN "EmployeeID" END) AS male_count,

    ROUND(
        (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "Gender" = 'Female' THEN "EmployeeID" END) * 100.0) 
        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Employee_Type = 'WC' THEN "EmployeeID" END), 0), 2
    ) AS female_pct,

    ROUND(
        (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "Gender" = 'Male' THEN "EmployeeID" END) * 100.0) 
        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "EmployeeID"), 0), 2
    ) AS male_pct,

    ROUND(
        (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "Gender" = 'Female' THEN "EmployeeID" END) * 100.0)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "EmployeeID"), 0), 2
    ) AS female_count_total_pct

FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_LOC01".HR."OD_Hire"
WHERE "Last_Working_Day" IS NULL
and Department in ($Department)

SELECT 
  max(CASE WHEN KPI = 'INTERNS HC' AND Type = 'Actual' THEN "Value" END) AS interns_count,
  max(CASE WHEN KPI = 'OUTSOURCE WC HC' AND Type = 'Actual' THEN "Value" END) AS outsource_count_wc,
  max(CASE WHEN KPI = 'OUTSOURCE BC HC' AND Type = 'Actual' THEN "Value" END) AS outsource_count_bc
FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_LOC01".HR."HR_KPI"  
WHERE TO_DATE("month", 'Month') = (
  SELECT MAX(TO_DATE("month", 'Month'))
  FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_LOC01".HR."HR_KPI"
  WHERE "year" = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE())
  and Area = 'OD / Recruitment'
);

SELECT 
  max(CASE WHEN KPI = 'Employee Meals Provided' AND Type = 'Actual' then concat(round("Value"/1000.0,0),'K') end) as employee_meals_actual,
  max(CASE WHEN KPI = 'Total Trips Transportation " Annually"' AND Type = 'Actual' then concat(round("Value"/1000.0,0),'K') end) as trips_actual
FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_LOC01".HR."HR_KPI"  
WHERE TO_DATE("month", 'Month') = (
  SELECT MAX(TO_DATE("month", 'Month'))
  FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_LOC01".HR."HR_KPI"
  where "year" = Year(Current_date())
  and Area in ('Security','Employee Relations')
)

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT EmployeeID) AS employee_count,
  CASE
    WHEN age < 20.0 THEN 'Under 20'
    WHEN age >= 20.0 AND age <= 29.0 THEN '20-29'
    WHEN age >= 30.0 AND age <= 39.0 THEN '30-39'
    WHEN age >= 40.0 AND age <= 49.0 THEN '40-49'
    WHEN age >=  50.0 AND age <= 60.0 THEN '50-60'
    when age > 60.0 then '60+'
  END AS age_range
FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_LOC01".HR."OD_Hire"
  where Last_Working_Day is  null
and Department in ($Department)

GROUP BY age_range
ORDER BY age_range;

SELECT
  -- Training Hours
  MAX(CASE WHEN KPI = ' Total Training Hours Annual' AND Type = 'Actual' 
      THEN concat(round("VALUE"/1000,0),'K') END) AS training_actual,

  MAX(CASE WHEN KPI = ' Total Training Hours Annual' AND Type = 'Target' 
      THEN concat(round("VALUE"/1000,0),'K') END) AS training_target,

  ROUND(
    (MAX(CASE WHEN KPI = ' Total Training Hours Annual' AND Type = 'Actual' THEN "VALUE" END) * 100.0) /
    NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN KPI = ' Total Training Hours Annual' AND Type = 'Target' THEN "VALUE" END),0)
  ,0) AS training_actual_percent,

  100 AS training_target_percent,

  -- Employees Covered %
  MAX(CASE WHEN KPI = ' Employees Covered from Total HC' AND Type = 'Actual' 
      THEN round("VALUE" * 100,0) END) AS employees_covered_actual,

  MAX(CASE WHEN KPI = ' Employees Covered from Total HC' AND Type = 'Target' 
      THEN round("VALUE" * 100,0) END) AS employees_covered_target,

  MAX(CASE WHEN KPI = ' Employees Covered from Total HC' AND Type = 'Actual' 
      THEN round("VALUE" * 100,0) END) AS employees_covered_actual_percent,

  MAX(CASE WHEN KPI = ' Employees Covered from Total HC' AND Type = 'Target' 
      THEN round("VALUE" * 100,0) END) AS employees_covered_target_percent

FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_LOC01".HR."HR_KPI"
WHERE KPI IN (' Total Training Hours Annual', ' Employees Covered from Total HC')
  AND TO_DATE("month", 'Month') = (
    SELECT MAX(TO_DATE("month", 'Month'))
    FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_LOC01".HR."HR_KPI"
    WHERE "year" = Year(Current_date())
      and Area = 'OD / Training'

  );

SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN age < 20.0 THEN EmployeeID END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT EmployeeID), 2) AS percentage_under_20,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN age BETWEEN 20.0 AND 29.0 THEN EmployeeID END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT EmployeeID), 2) AS percentage_20_29,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN age BETWEEN 30.0 AND 39.0 THEN EmployeeID END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT EmployeeID), 2) AS percentage_30_39,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN age BETWEEN 40.0 AND 49.0 THEN EmployeeID END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT EmployeeID), 2) AS percentage_40_49,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN age BETWEEN 50.0 AND 59.0 THEN EmployeeID END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT EmployeeID), 2) AS percentage_50_59,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN age >= 60.0 THEN EmployeeID END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT EmployeeID), 2) AS percentage_60_plus
FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_LOC01".HR."OD_Hire"
WHERE Last_Working_Day IS NULL;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT EmployeeID) AS "Total Employees",
  Employee_Group
FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_LOC01".HR."OD_Hire"
WHERE Last_Working_Day IS NULL
  AND Employee_Type = 'WC'
  and Department in ($Department)

GROUP BY Employee_Group
ORDER BY CASE Employee_Group
    WHEN 'Junior' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Senior' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Section Head' THEN 3
    WHEN 'Assistant Manager' THEN 4
    WHEN 'Manager' THEN 5
    WHEN 'Director' THEN 6
  END;

SELECT
  count (distinct EmployeeID) as "Total Employees" , Employee_Type 
 FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_LOC01".HR."OD_Hire"
where Last_Working_Day is  null
and Department in ($Department)

group by Employee_Type

SELECT count(DISTINCT EmployeeID),"ReasonOfLeaving"
FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_LOC01".HR."OD_Hire"
where  Last_Working_Day is not null
and Department in ($Department)
group by ReasonOfLeaving
order by count(DISTINCT EmployeeID) desc

SELECT
  count (distinct EmployeeID) as "Total Employees" , Sub_Department 
 FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_LOC01".HR."OD_Hire"
  where Last_Working_Day is  null
  and Department in ($Department)
and Employee_Type = 'BC'
group by Sub_Department 
order by "Total Employees" desc
limit 5

SELECT
  count (distinct EmployeeID) as "Total Employees" , Department 
 FROM "EG_CA_TRU_FAC_LOC01".HR."OD_Hire"
  where Last_Working_Day is  null
and Employee_Type = 'WC'
group by Department 
order by "Total Employees" desc
limit 5
